_about: Words for the website samples. Written to the same rules as the live affirmation writer (Website Orders module 14) and the house writing rules: first person, present tense, plain words, the wanted thing stated as already true, no negations, no medical claims, no gendered words. The sport set also follows the sport psychology rules. 5 lines each, spoken with the same voice, settings and 1.7 second gaps as real orders.

calmer-parenting.label: Calmer parenting
lines: When my children need me, I stay calm.
Before I answer, I take a slow breath.
My voice is kind, even on a busy morning.
Patience comes easily to me as a parent.
Each day I give myself the same kindness I give my family.

career-work.label: Career & work
lines: My work is good, and I know it.
In meetings, I speak up with confidence.
Asking for what I need at work feels natural to me.
My ideas are worth sharing.
At the end of each day, I know I did my best.

confidence-self-esteem.label: Confidence & self-esteem
lines: I like who I am.
My own judgement is worth trusting.
When I speak, my words are clear and calm.
Every step I have taken so far makes me proud.
Good things belong in my life.

focus-productivity.label: Focus & productivity
lines: One task at a time gets my full attention.
My work starts straight away.
What I begin, I finish.
Today I know exactly what matters most.
Calm, steady work comes easily to me.

gratitude-self-love.label: Gratitude & self-love
lines: Each day, I notice something good.
My words to myself are kind.
Looking at my life, I feel grateful.
I am worthy of love and care.
Everything I do each day is worth appreciating.

grief-heartbreak-letting-go.label: Grief, heartbreak & letting go
lines: Whatever I feel today is allowed.
I am gentle with myself.
The good memories stay with me.
Support is something I let in.
Each day, I take things as they come.

health-vitality.label: Health & vitality
lines: My choices help me feel well.
Moving every day is something I enjoy.
Rest is part of how I look after myself.
Looking after myself makes me proud.
Every day, I make time for the things that give me energy.

money-abundance.label: Money & abundance
lines: I look at my money calmly.
Clear decisions about spending and saving come naturally to me.
Managing money is something I do well.
My work has value, and so does what it earns.
With confidence, I plan for the future.

motivation.label: Motivation
lines: Today I take the first step.
When a task takes time, I keep going.
Keeping my word comes naturally to me.
Every bit of progress feels good.
Following through is who I am.

relationships-connection.label: Relationships & connection
lines: I listen with care.
When I share my feelings, I share them kindly.
The people who matter to me get my time.
My friendships are warm and honest.
Giving and receiving love comes easily to me.

sleep.label: Sleep
lines: I settle easily at bedtime.
At night, my mind is calm.
Before I sleep, I put the day down.
Lying down, I relax fully.
Each morning, I wake up feeling rested.

stress-anxiety-relief.label: Stress & anxiety relief
lines: Slow breaths help me feel calm.
One thing at a time is how I handle my day.
Whatever today brings, I trust myself to cope.
When I need calm, I know how to find it.
Rest is part of my day.

sport.label: Sports confidence
lines: My training is with me, and I trust it.
The nerves before I start mean I am ready.
After a mistake, I reset and focus on the next action.
I see myself making the next move cleanly and with confidence.
Eyes on the target.
